summary: v0.6.9 brings faster, more stable Custom Tags previews, immediate card moves without a full-grid reload, and profile-local runtime temp, cache, and catalog work data.

whatsNew.title: Faster, steadier previews
whatsNew.copy: Custom Tags previews load faster and stay stable as you browse.

whatsNew.title: Immediate card moves
whatsNew.copy: Move cards between folders and see the change without reloading the full grid.

whatsNew.title: Work stays with your profile
whatsNew.copy: Runtime temp, cache, and catalog work stay with this profile.

cleanupNotice.title: A note about older system temporary files
cleanupNotice.copy: We're sorry. v0.6.9 restores installed runtime temporary files to the installed app's own profile directory at data/temp instead of the Windows system %TEMP%. Cache files stay in data/cache. Earlier builds could duplicate preview, cache, and temporary files in the system location and consume substantial system-drive space. Historical leftovers are not removed automatically.
steps: Close NAI Prompt Studio and its installer.
First, use Windows Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files and review and remove temporary files.
For targeted cleanup, press Win+R, enter %TEMP%, and remove only clearly identifiable old NAI Prompt Studio, Electron, or ASAR-related leftovers. Skip anything in use or uncertain.
